title: Update Contact Us footer address

requirements.text:
Update the address block in the Footer component (frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx) to display the following address:

Sharath M
12th Cross, Mookambika Nagar
Banashankari 3rd Stage
Hosakerehalli
Bangalore – 560085

The email htrustfix@gmail.com must remain unchanged.
